headline: Gross margin expands as sales and EPS advance
summary_short: Snap-on's Q2 2026 net sales rose 4.7% to $1,235.1 million (organic +3.0%), while diluted EPS increased 5.1% y/y to $4.96 as gross margin expanded to 51.4% from 50.5% a year ago.
summary_long: Total revenue rose 4.2% y/y to $1,334.8 million on a 3.0% organic sales gain across all segments, plus acquisition and FX tailwinds. Gross margin improved to 51.4% from 50.5%. Commercial & Industrial operating margin jumped 330bp to 16.8% on higher volumes; Snap-on Tools Group and Repair Systems & Information Group margins each compressed as costs outpaced sales growth. Diluted EPS rose 5.1% y/y to $4.96. Cash fell to $1,644.7 million from $1,753.3 million q/q after $91.4 million of buybacks and $126.4 million of dividends. Management reiterated FY2026 capex near $100 million and a ~22% tax rate; no revenue or EPS guidance given.
